signal: max(forecast level q05-q95, absolute half-hour forecast ramp divided by calibration q95); calibrate only on 2022 forecasts

failure.event: any nominated baseline or dispatcher request cannot be delivered within power or energy limits
failure.threshold_scope: analyst finite-population feasibility criterion, not a market permission to disregard instructions

windows.population: all complete windows inside each fixed ten-day development sample; common reset inventory per diagnostic window

gate: advance only if at least one of the actual 64 library profiles is empirically feasible in all three development samples and at least one library profile is infeasible in at least one sample; extra constants do not open the gate
registration_context: P1 development and oracle outcomes known; P2 development acceptances and whole-site policy outcomes not yet observed
role: paired development feasibility repair, not independent confirmation

asset.name: Pillswood site simulation
asset.power_basis: 98 MW published combined grid connection; impose sum of absolute unit powers <=98 MW as a conservative simulation throughput bound, not measured inverter throughput
asset.energy_basis: 196 MWh published site capacity, modeled as pooled usable inventory; no measured unit SOC or energy allocation
asset.identity_basis: retained 2026 Elexon reference names Pillswood 1 and Pillswood 2; current 49.9 MW registry fields do not set historical unit limits

control.target_soc: same quantized policy and 2022-calibrated forecast stress, multiplied by 196 MWh
control.forecast_visibility: delivery-period and preceding forecasts must have publishTime no later than nomination time
control.projection: project pending hour and next delivery half-hour using only BOA segments received by current decision; preserve gross flows and their losses
control.command: equal split of one site nomination across two BM units; choose bounded site power to reach the target at end of delivery half-hour after known BOA overrides
control.execution: latest received covering BOA overrides baseline separately for each unit; the idle unit retains its own half of the nomination
control.request_visibility: acceptanceTime is the simulated receipt time; no future receipts used
control.integration: exact piecewise-linear gross energy, split at zero and power limits
control.supported_time_grid: instruction timeFrom/timeTo/acceptanceTime on whole UTC minutes, as in the supplied ordinary BOA data
control.physical_bounds: terminate a diagnostic window on its first gross-throughput or exact pooled-inventory violation; no full-window cost assigned to failed trajectories

cost.objective: net metered-energy procurement proxy in GBP plus inventory mark-to-market adjustment
cost.flows: sum APXMIDP[t] * (delivered_import_MWh - delivered_export_MWh), including baseline and instruction flows
cost.inventory_adjustment: charge_efficiency is not used for sale value: lambda_T = discharge_efficiency * final settlement-period MID; add lambda_T * (common_initial_SOC - final_SOC)
cost.price_visibility: realized prices and lambda_T are accounting outcomes only; the controller never observes them
cost.scope: MID-indexed accounting on completed physically feasible windows only; failed windows have no full-window economic outcome

model_assumptions: pooled site inventory permits virtual sharing between BM units; a successful simulation does not prove physical unit-level feasibility
equal baseline split is an analyst control assumption; per-unit SOC, usable energy, and converter limits were not observed
gross absolute power bound is stricter than the published net grid limit and can create conservative false infeasibility
historical BOAs held fixed despite their dependence on actual baseline and availability; other commitments absent
fixed development sample windows overlap; 95% success is a finite-population development criterion
nominations model a one-hour information lead; exact order execution, BM settlement, and degradation absent
